SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'WHAN') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, GR_DATE, UNIT_PRICE, GR_QTY, GR_AMT, ADD_USER_ID, KEY_1 AS PLANT, KEY_2 AS ADD_DATE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$'
